rows.decision_rationale: Accepted as metal_dependent_hydrolase. Fungal zincin metalloprotease/deuterolysin; Zn present. Asp143 metal ligand and Tyr106 electrostatic stabilizer fit zincin geometry.
mechanism_text_snippets: Glu 129 and Zn together act to activate a water molecule so that it can act as a nucleophile to attack the peptide substrate. This forms a tetrahedral intermediate, stabilised by proton donation by Tyr 106, which then collapses to release the products.
